name: Gaza Combat and Humanitarian Catastrophe
title: Israel–Palestine · Gaza Combat and Humanitarian Catastrophe

definition.question: How intense is combat in Gaza and how severe is humanitarian collapse?
definition.low_end: A sustained ceasefire holds with minimal combat, effective civilian protection, and adequate humanitarian aid, medical care and reconstruction access across Gaza.
definition.high_end: Sustained high-intensity combat with mass civilian casualties, famine and total collapse of medical and aid systems, and large-scale forced displacement across Gaza.
